tokenize_code: tokenize source code into a list of tokens using tree-sitter AST parsing with optional comment handling
get_tokens_and_types: get tokens and their corresponding AST node types from source code via tree-sitter DFS traversal
detokenize_code: detokenize a list of tokens back into formatted source code with proper indentation and string reconstruction
extract_functions: extract standalone and class methods from source code using tree-sitter AST and optionally re-tokenize them
traverse_tree: traverse a tree-sitter AST tree yielding final leaf nodes with configurable terminal node types
